requested: consolidate the complete distillation, playback, and G1 maintenance surface in one execution
preserved: training math, tensors, datasets, collection order, checkpoint, Hydra, reward, observation, action, DR, reset, RNG, simulator, and playback behavior
forbidden: semantic changes, generic framework introduction, branch creation, commit, push, live simulation, training, deployment, and destructive cleanup

source_edits.receipt: user approved the design and requested one-shot execution

repository_discipline.rationale: AGENTS.md requires owner-layer changes, thin scripts, backend isolation, contract preservation, nearby validation, uv run, and no unapproved branch creation

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: contracts, datasets, collection, learning, workflow, runtime, FADA, playback, and G1 framework bindings each have a named production owner

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: current repository imports remain direct re-exports only where a real consumer exists; package and CLI signatures remain unchanged

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: the plan specifies an acyclic lower-level-to-orchestration graph and forbids scripts, workflow, playback, and backend reverse dependencies

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: optimizer, collection, artifact, worker, viewer, backend, rollout, reset, and curriculum state each retain one lifecycle owner

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: the complete repeatedly-refactored surface is one bounded behavior-neutral transaction with no deferred local split

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: offline behavior preservation and maintainability only; runtime, convergence, checkpoint quality, and deployment are not claimed

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED import/behavior characterization, owner-focused GREEN tests, affected suites, full tests, lint, compile, dependency, diff, recount, and final R2 review are specified

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: moves preserve tensor values, shape, dtype, device, masks, row/window order, and same-state Oracle identity

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: BehaviorDistillationTrainer remains the sole model, optimizer, gradient, teacher-evaluation, and update-count owner

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: checkpoint schemas, artifact atomicity, identity, resume, cleanup, and commit-last ordering are frozen and explicitly tested

residual_risks: The checkout already contains a broad user-owned uncommitted refactor; construction must compare against the exact dirty baseline and avoid reverting overlapping work.
